context_page.note: Certain. p271 carries two chapter headings: 'Lib:IV:Cap:29.' at top of column 1 (items 1-3 run down columns 1-2) and 'Lib:IV:Cap:30.' at top of column 3 (item 1 'allerleÿ Music und Besänge an zu richten', item 2 'Daß die [Geister/Beister] in gestalt der Affen allerleÿ seltzame Täntze fürstellen'). Column 3 ends with Cap 30 item 2, so Cap 30 is running at the bottom.

pages.note: Single ruled column at the left of the page holding two grids (Cap 30 items 3 and 4), continuing Cap 30 from p271 without a new chapter heading. Right two-thirds of the page carries a large red decorative 'ENDE' (end of Book IV); nothing after it. Written page number '269' at top left. Faint show-through of p271 grids visible at right; not ink on this page. Items rise 3, 4 after p271's 1, 2: no skip or repeat. Item 4's short heading is close in wording to Cap 30 item 2 on p271 (both 'Daß die ... in gestalt der Affen allerleÿ sel[t]zame ...'), but the endings differ (p271: 'Täntze fürstellen'; here: 'Sprünge und Poßen machen').
